name: Cybernetic Zombie

reactions.name: Self-Destruct
reactions.description:
A cybernetic zombie must use this reaction unless its cybernetics are disabled

Trigger The cybernetic zombie is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The zombie's damaged cybernetics explode, dealing @Damage[1d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic|options:area-effect] save). This ability destroys the zombie's integrated items and any tech items on the zombie of 1st level or lower.

actions.name: Cybernetics
actions.description: A cybernetic zombie's cybernetics can be disabled for 1 hour by a creature that succeeds at a DC 15 check to [[/act disable-device dc=15]] or Disable a System. Attempting to do so can typically be done only while within reach of the zombie and is a 2-action activity that has the manipulate trait. The cybernetics are also disabled for 1 hour if the zombie takes any electricity damage. A cybernetic zombie with disabled cybernetics is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use any reactions.

notes: Strikes/defenses are a direct transcription of the real bestiary statblock (gamesystems/sf2e/packs/alien-core-bestiary) — see test/character-builder/extract-npc.test.mjs. Level -1 HP-sponge pick (design doc §76 Phase 4, GH #64's own suggested-ten survey, HP 40 vs. every other level -1..0 pick's 7-26): Laser Pistol (ranged, tech) and Fist (unarmed melee) both derive unmodified through the existing toCombatant. "Self-Destruct" is a real reaction, captured under `reactions` for transcript honesty, not mechanically wired — its trigger (real death) is a structurally different shape from the one reaction this engine fires (GH #18's movement-triggered Reactive Strike). "Cybernetics"/"Void Healing" are real passives, captured under `actions`, not mechanically wired (this engine has no positive-vs-negative-healing-polarity mechanism for the latter).
